Associated Industries of Massachusetts has been admitted into this proceeding as a Limited Participant. A.I.M. has been added to the attached updated service lists, may attend the public portion of any evidentiary hearing and technical conferences, receive copies of all pleadings, discovery requests and responses, and submit written comments and briefs. Attached please find updated service lists and amended Ground Rules. The amended Ground Rules reflect the parties' agreement to receive documents via email, except as otherwise directed (ie hard copies to the Department and Bay State Gas Company). The amended Ground Rules also allow for a ten calendar day response time for Information Requests as opposed to the seven day response time in the initial Ground Rules. Procedural schedule will follow.
